rights.attribution: CelesTrak; USSPACECOM / 18th Space Defense Squadron via Space-Track.org.
rights.fieldProvenance: GP elements and catalogue fields are attributed to their source. Group membership and docking relationships are provider-supplied snapshot facts, not reconstructed historical events. Operating-status enrichment is omitted.

model.earthFixed: GMST rotation to PEF; UT1 approximated by UTC, polar motion omitted
model.epochPrecision: JavaScript milliseconds; source sub-millisecond fraction retained in evidence but truncated by the library (< 1 ms)
model.interpolation: none; direct SGP4 at every sample
model.selection: Latest epoch per decimal-string NORAD ID. Ties preserve source order stations, gnss, geo. Keep all source group memberships; one moving glyph per independent identity. Exclude attachments from independent propagation, expose them under their parent. Age eligibility can change across the frozen study.
model.attachmentPolicy: Frozen SATCAT attachment relationship across the study; no docking/undocking history reconstructed.
model.eligibility: Absolute element offset <= 24 hours, intersected with the declared study window. Source age does not supply covariance or a guaranteed positional error.
